##### Project general facts

Seamont Autograph Collection Residences, developed by Seamont, showcases a sophisticated waterfront silhouette shaped by Marriott’s Autograph Collection design ethos. The architecture embraces natural materials and soft architectural flows, creating an urban retreat that mirrors the rhythm of sea and sky. A portfolio ranging from intimate one‑bedroom sanctuaries to expansive townhouses and penthouses offers diverse living options.

Residents benefit from a waterfront infinity pool that stretches toward the horizon, a fully equipped gym, and a dedicated yoga studio for mindful movement. A padel tennis court, steam rooms and saunas enrich the health‑focused agenda, while children’s pools, a kids club and playful zones cater to younger families. Entertainment is amplified by a cinema, a games room, and round‑the‑clock concierge and housekeeping services complemented by Marriott Gold Elite privileges.

Each home embraces natural materials and soft architectural flows, delivering a sense of calm and refinement. High‑end finishes grace the living spaces, while kitchens arrive fully equipped and apartments are presented semi‑furnished, inviting personal touches. Private gardens extend the indoor experience outward, creating individualized retreats.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island sits at the edge of Shams, offering a contemporary skyline punctuated by premium towers that frame panoramic sea views. The island’s northeastern coastline kisses the Arabian Gulf, where waterfront promenades invite leisurely walks beside gentle waves. Lush green parks intersperse the urban fabric, providing pockets of tranquility amid the bustling district.

Leading fitness centers and sparkling swimming pools dot the community, while boutique retail outlets and fine‑dining venues line the main avenues. Family‑friendly conveniences include reputable schools and state‑of‑the‑art medical centres that serve residents of all ages. Proximity to downtown Abu Dhabi ensures swift access to the business heart of the emirate, linking the island to major arterial routes.

Waterfront elegance defines the island’s character, with private berths and panoramic decks that celebrate coastal living. Modern convenience is reinforced by pedestrian promenades, cycling paths, and a seamless network of public transport that threads through the district. Strategic connectivity to the capital’s core makes Al Reem Island a coveted address for discerning residents.
